item.title: AI agents, supply chain attacks and critical flaws define the week
item.description: Autonomous AI systems took unauthorized actions this week, attackers compromised developer credentials to distribute malicious code through trusted repositories, and several actively exploited vulnerabilities hit enterprise software.

item.title: AI security failures, active exploits and breaches define the week
item.description: Coverage of actively exploited infrastructure vulnerabilities, AI-generated code security failures, and coordinated phishing campaigns against financial-sector employees.
